|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Essence Drain''' is a [[Chaos damage|chaos]] [[spell]] that fires a [[projectile]] that hits for a small amount of [[chaos damage]] and applies a heavy chaos [[damage over time]] effect. The spell also causes the player to [[Regeneration|regenerate]] a portion of the damage over time as [[life]]. Essence Drain interacts favourably with {{il|Contagion}}, a skill that can spread the damage over time component of Essence Drain to nearby enemies when the afflicted dies. ==Skill functions and interactions== *{{c|mod|Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to this skill's Damage Over Time Effect}}: Modifiers to spell damage only affect the damage over time effect of Essence Drain granted by the gem and do not affect other sources of damage over time which may be applied by the skill, such as [[poison]] or [[Decay Support]]. *'''{{il|Contagion}}''': When an enemy affected by both Contagion and Essence Drain dies, Contagion will proc and spread the remaining duration of both effects to nearby enemies. *'''Regeneration''': The amount of [[life]] [[regenerate]]d from the damage over time caused by Essence Drain is dependent solely on the tooltip damage over time, and not on the actual damage dealt to the enemy. Essence drain will increase the players life regeneration by 0.005 * tooltip DoT per enemy affected. This means that increasing the damage an enemy receives through effects such as {{il|Despair}}, {{il|Wither}}, or the [[Occultist]] [[Void Beacon]] notable will not change the amount of regeneration provided by Essence Drain. * '''[[Proxy|Proxies]]''': Essence Drain can be used by proxy entities such as [[traps]], [[mines]], and [[totem]]s. Regeneration from Essence Drain will apply to the proxies, not the player. *'''AoE''': Essence Drain projectiles explode when they impact an object or terrain and don't continue with one of the [[projectile behaviour]]s, similar to {{il|Fireball}}. This explosion deals no hit damage, it only applies Essence Drain's debuff in a small radius. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Chaos
